purpose: Describe how a human or an AI agent can discover, retrieve and verify this static laboratory.

human_access.accessibility: Semantic HTML, keyboard-visible focus, skip links, text alternatives and a no-JavaScript reading path.

availability.schedule: On every main branch update and every six hours.
checks: HTTPS response status 200 for human and machine entrypoints.
Expected content type and non-empty response body.
Canonical links, titles, descriptions, language and basic image alternatives on HTML pages.
Valid JSON, synchronized payment manifests and required endpoint references.
No broken internal href or src path in the public HTML.
availability.success_definition: A check passes only when required routes return expected content and the canonical machine-readable documents agree.

consultation.reason: GitHub Pages serves static files and this site does not expose visitor logs.
consultation.future_measurement: Add privacy-preserving analytics or access-log measurement only after the provider, consent, retention and bot-separation rules are documented on the public policy page.
